title: Recepcionista (Auditor Noturno)
description:
No Hilton , acreditamos que cada chegada deve ser uma experiência calorosa e cada saída, uma vontade de voltar. Nossa equipe de Recepção é o primeiro sorriso do hotel — aquele que dá o tom da hospitalidade Hilton, reconhecida mundialmente por excelência, cuidado e autenticidade.

Se você gosta de acolher pessoas, criar experiências memoráveis e deseja trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, elegante e com forte cultura de serviço, esta oportunidade é para você. Como Recepcionista , você será parte essencial da jornada do hóspede, garantindo atendimento impecável, personalizado e alinhado aos padrões internacionais da marca Hilton.

Descrição da posição

Responsável direto pelo atendimento a hóspedes e clientes com o objetivo de contribuir para uma experiência excepcional desde o momento do check-in ao check-out, conforme padrões estabelecidos pela empresa, bem como a resolução de eventuais desafios que possam surgir.

  • Responsável pela primeira impressão dos hóspedes e clientes do hotel.
  • Promover os serviços dos pontos de venda do hotel.
  • Administrar o fundo fixo de caixa de forma adequada, respeitando os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Fechamento de caixa, verificando todos os lançamentos para que estes estejam condizentes com as comandas preenchidas e assinadas; conferir o fundo de caixa diariamente, sendo que este deve ser com o valor estabelecido pelo departamento financeiro para o membro de equipe.
  • Prestar informações a hóspedes, clientes e a equipe sempre que solicitado, atendendo a possíveis necessidades e garantindo satisfação a todos.
  • Completar o processo de registro dos hóspedes (check-in) seguindo os padrões de qualidade da Marca Canopy, utilizando o sistema eletrônico adotado pela empresa, selecionando apartamento através das preferências dos hóspedes, previamente associadas à reserva, ou solicitadas in loco.
  • Solicitar o preenchimento de Ficha Nacional de Registro de Hóspedes (FNRH) e atualizar o sistema.
  • No caso de hóspedes ilustres ou muito importantes, solicitar o acompanhamento do Gerente de Hospedagem ou Gerente Assistente de plantão para registro privativo na habitação.
  • Possuir conhecimento de todas as categorias dos apartamentos, e particularidades como: tamanhos dos quartos, tipos de camas, características particulares em geral.
  • Conhece as tarifas especiais e programas corporativos incluindo descontos, serviços e amenities.
  • Mantêm-se informado sobre entradas /saídas, ocupação diária e mensal do hotel.
  • Efetua pré-registro dos hóspedes.
  • Completar o processo de saída dos hóspedes (check-out) através do sistema eletrônico adotado pela empresa, imprimindo o extrato de conta para conferência do hóspede.
  • Atender à solicitações diversas de hóspedes – chamadas de despertar, dúvidas sobre a cidade, ajuda com localização, entre outros.
  • Manter-se informado sobre atrações da cidade e localizações, para poder informar ao hóspede.
  • Atender ligações dentro do padrão da empresa, resolver pendências trocando informações diversas com outros departamentos, como por exemplo Reservas.
  • Verificar organização e limpeza do balcão, limpeza de escaninhos, impressão de documentos, reposição dos materiais de escritório e formulários.
  • Verificar reservas do dia através do relatório ou Gerente Assistente, assim como eventos e grupos.
  • Acompanhamento de hóspedes em emergências.
  • Efetuar chamadas telefônicas para hóspedes no balcão quando solicitado.
  • Otimizar atendimento aos hóspedes fazendo o serviço prestado o mais breve e personalizado possível;
  • Atingir metas estabelecidas pela empresa quanto à formulários de satisfação de hóspedes preenchidos e novas inscrições ao programa HHonors e Upsellings.
  • Se apresentar pontualmente ao trabalho, cumprir com horários estipulados e dentro dos padrões de apresentação pessoal estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Ser flexível a mudanças de escalas de acordo com as necessidades operacionais do hotel.
  • Conhecer todos os padrões de qualidade da marca Canopy.
  • Manter bom relacionamento com todos os departamentos do hotel.
  • Participa de treinamentos de capacitação oferecidos pela empresa para o seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Zelar por todos os equipamentos de trabalho e reportar qualquer problema de funcionamento as áreas responsáveis.

Relações de trabalho

Cargos que se reportam diretamente a este cargo (títulos): Nenhum

Conhecimento específico e habilidades

  • Inglês e espanhol fluentes para se comunicar efetivamente com hóspedes, clientes e equipe.
  • Habilidade de trabalhar com muitas atividades ao mesmo tempo.
  • Ser imparcial quando tiver que ouvir críticas e resolver conflitos.
  • Ser resiliente com habilidade de trabalhar sob pressão e lidar com situações estressantes durante períodos de alto movimento.
  • Ser proativo e sempre se antecipar a necessidades de hóspedes clientes.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Superior completo em Hotelaria, Turismo ou áreas afins.
  • Habilidade de trabalhar com público.
  • Ser criativo e possuir personalidade espontânea e assertiva para lidar com hóspedes e clientes.
  • Facilidades com sistemas informatizados.
  • Ser organizado e possuir habilidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Experiência de 02 a 03 anos anterior em hotelaria no cargo de Recepção.

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita

title: Coordenador
description:
• Lotação: Extensão e Internacionalização (IMPA Tech)
  • Quantidade de vagas: 1
  • Horário de trabalho: de 8:30h às 17:30h, de segunda a sexta-feira

Principais atribuições e responsabilidades

  • Implementar políticas de internacionalização alinhadas às normas do MEC;
  • Gerenciar a mobilidade de alunos, docentes e técnicos (ida para o exterior e parcerias no Brasil);
  • Apoiar a recepção e integração de professores e alunos estrangeiros (hospitalidade acadêmica);
  • Prospectar, abordar e negociar novos convênios de mobilidade com instituições estrangeiras de interesse estratégico para as áreas de conhecimento do IMPA Tech;
  • Gerenciar o orçamento da área, buscando captação de recursos via editais de fomento à internacionalização;
  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades de extensão, garantindo a indissociabilidade entre ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Coordenar campanhas de divulgação interna e externa dos programas de mobilidade, em parceria com outros setores;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das diretrizes do MEC e indicadores do INEP para extensão;
  • Estimular a participação de docentes e alunos em projetos de impacto na comunidade externa;
  • Promover a divulgação das atividades de extensão e de seus resultados junto à comunidade interna e externa;
  • Emitir certificações e relatórios de desempenho das atividades realizadas;
  • Gerir contratos, aquisições de bens e serviços da coordenação;
  • Manter registros atualizados para fins de avaliação institucional (SINAES) e relatórios de gestão; e
  • Assessorar a Diretoria e a Gerência Acadêmica em temas regulatórios e estratégicos.

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência em iniciativas relacionadas à extensão e/ou internacionalização universitárias em organizações de caráter educacional, científico, cultural ou correlatas; e
  • Fluência avançada (C1/C2) no idioma Inglês (escrita, leitura e conversação).

Requisitos desejáveis para o cargo

  • Pós-graduação em Gestão do Ensino Superior ou Gestão Acadêmica, Relações
    Internacionais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com o Sistema e-MEC e Censos;
  • Experiência prática na implementação da Resolução CNE/CES nº 7/2018, garantindo o cumprimento da carga horária obrigatória de 10% e a integração com a sociedade;
  • Domínio das normas do MEC, INEP (indicadores de graduação) e SINAES;
  • Vivência internacional (acadêmica ou profissional);
  • Capacidade de convencer e mobilizar o corpo docente sobre a importância e os benefícios da extensão e da internacionalização; e
  • Fluência em um terceiro idioma (ex: Espanhol, Mandarim, Alemão).

title: Analista Comercial Sênior
description:
Analista Comercial Sênior

Requisitos que não podem faltar:

  • Formação Superior Completa em: Marketing, Publicidade, Engenharia ou outras áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Leitura e interpretação de MDTR, DDD, PMB, AUDIT.
  • Análise de ROI e entendimento de margem e elasticidade promocional.
  • Capacidade de gerar apresentações executivas e narrativas de negócios.

Principais Atividades:

  • Consolidar e analisar dados provenientes de auditorias (MDTR, DDD, PMB, AUDIT) para geração de insights.
  • Construir dashboards de performance (mês, YTD, MAT) e indicadores estratégicos para reuniões com gerência e diretoria.
  • Avaliar desempenho por canal, categoria, cliente, ciclo promocional e mix de produtos.
  • Elaborar análises de ROI das ações promocionais em parceria com Comercial e Trade.
  • Monitorar KPIs-chave: sell‑in, sell‑out, positivação, cobertura e execução de ações.
  • Monitorar KPIs de campanhas (engajamento, ROI, conversão) e reportar resultados.
  • Acompanhar performance de ações e eventos, propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhamento de indicadores e metas.
  • Apoiar o planejamento comercial, ciclos e campanhas, integrando Marketing, Trade e Comercial.
  • Preparar materiais executivos com tendências, oportunidades, mapas de distribuição e análises para apresentações gerenciais.
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas (internas e com distribuidores) fornecendo dados e argumentos baseados em performance e ROI.
  • Organizar agendas, materiais e relatórios das reuniões de ciclo comercial.
  • Acompanhar e controlar dados referentes a Cartas Acordo (conferência, prazos, alocação e histórico, sendo corresponsável no processo de negociação).
  • Gerenciar calendário promocional e fluxo de informações entre áreas (Marketing, Trade e Comercial).
Competências:
  • Pensamento analítico e orientado a dados.
  • Comunicação executiva.
  • Organização e disciplina em rotinas de performance.
  • Colaboração interdisciplinar.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono.

Oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica Bradesco Seguros com desconto mensal.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo.
  • Previdência Privada.
  • Ticket‑Refeição no valor de R$ 65,00/dia.
  • Vale‑Alimentação no valor de R$ 550,00/mês.
  • Auxílio‑Creche para colaboradores do sexo feminino, com filhos até 2 anos.
  • Wellhub.
  • Vale Transporte.
  • Estacionamento no local.
  • PLR anual.

description:
Overview

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

  • Accreditation Documentation & Content Management: Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Training Material Development & Delivery: Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.
  • Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination: Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

Your profile

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Responsible for managing local distributor partners/intermediaries/resellers. Accountable for the development as well as the execution of the indirect sales strategy and delivering financial performance targets through robust Joint Business Plans and monitoring performance to ensure long-term sustainable value for the company.

Execute the annual and multi-year strategic plans for indirect sales. Develop channel strategies to improve the value chain and ensure excellent standards and delivery to customers. Promote and lead delivery through the SmartGains framework, manage KPI implementation, and ensure distributors have the capabilities to execute with excellence. Support distributors in building value-case testimonials and share best practices.

Make joint customer calls with Platinum distributors to support capability development and SmartGains implementation. Develop customer and market insights to enable brand distinctiveness and feed the offer pipeline. Lead virtual customer account teams with support from Customer Operations, GBS, and Technical Service teams, with clear delegation of responsibilities.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for protecting the organization's information systems and digital assets by developing, implementing, and maintaining technical security controls. This role includes conducting security assessments, monitoring systems for vulnerabilities or intrusions, and ensuring that the organization’s IT environment remains compliant with industry and regulatory standards such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. The engineer also plays a critical role in incident detection, response, and prevention.

Supervisory Authority

NONE

Nature And Scope

Operating in a dynamic threat landscape, the Cybersecurity Engineer reports to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity and works with other IT, compliance, and business stakeholders. Although not a supervisory role, the Cybersecurity Engineer may guide junior staff or external contractors and lead technical implementation efforts on security‑related projects. The role demands staying up to date on emerging threats, tools, and best practices, and proactively evolving the organization's defenses accordingly.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security configuration reviews.
  • Evaluate system and application hardening measures using CIS benchmarks and STIGs.
  • Monitor networks and endpoints using tools like SIEM, EDR, and IDS/IPS (e.g., CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
  • Analyze security events and logs to detect, triage, and respond to threats.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools, including:
    • Firewalls
    • Network Access Control (NAC)
    • Antivirus/Endpoint Protection
    • DLP, CASB, and vulnerability management platforms
  • Develop and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external frameworks such as NIST 800‑53, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI DSS.
  • Develop and deliver training on phishing, password hygiene, and secure computing practices.
  • Support tabletop exercises and simulation drills to test security readiness.
  • Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security into system architecture.
  • Participate in project reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the system development lifecycle.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in the following:
    • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
    • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, CA
    • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
    • Falcon Crowdstrike
    • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
    • Hybrid cloud integrations
    • Authentication protocols
    • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper‑V).
  • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE.
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations.
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security.
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Deep understanding of encryption, PKI, authentication, secure networking, and operating system security across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Proficient in analyzing logs, threat intelligence, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) to drive timely threat mitigation.
  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Methodical and responsive approach to detecting, responding to, and remediating security incidents.
  • Works cross‑functionally with IT, audit, compliance, and legal to promote enterprise‑wide security awareness and enforcement.
  • Careful review of systems, code, and configurations to identify small changes that may indicate large risks.
  • Able to shift priorities rapidly in response to new vulnerabilities, threat campaigns, or business requirements.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four‑year college or university in computer science/Information Technology with a security concentration. A master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Must have 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a security engineering role. One or more industry‑recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer Associate is required or strongly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate hands‑on expertise in network and application security architecture, cloud security controls across platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP, identity and access management (including IAM, SSO, and MFA), and security monitoring tools such as SIEM, SOAR, and EDR. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and secure DevSecOps practices is essential. A solid understanding of key regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements—including GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA, and FISMA—is also required. In addition to technical capabilities, the candidate should possess strong collaboration and critical thinking skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$130,000–$140,000

title: Oficial Gasista|Hidráulico - Hospital Municipal Souza Aguiar
description:
Overview

Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro. Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.

Quem somos?

Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional experiente e dedicado para integrar nossa equipe como Bombeiro Hidráulico Gasista. O profissional será responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de tubulações de água, esgoto e, principalmente, de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, interpretando projetos e garantindo a segurança e a conformidade técnica das instalações.

Dia a Dia

  • Instalação e reparo de tubulações de água (fria e quente) e esgoto sanitário.
  • Montagem, construção e manutenção de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, conforme projetos.
  • Interpretação de projetos hidráulicos, sanitários e de gás para a correta implantação dos sistemas.
  • Realização de reparos em canos, vazamentos, sistemas hidráulicos e desobstrução de tubulações e ralos.
  • Montagem, instalação e manutenção de aquecedores, aparelhos a gás e outros equipamentos.
  • Utilização de técnicas e equipamentos especializados para identificar e reparar vazamentos de gás, garantindo a segurança.
  • Execução de testes para verificar a segurança, a ausência de vazamentos e a eficiência das instalações de gás e hidráulicas.
  • Realização de manutenção de primeiro nível em máquinas e equipamentos utilizados durante os serviços.
  • Preparação e organização do local de trabalho, garantindo o cumprimento de procedimentos e normas regulamentadoras de saúde, segurança no trabalho e meio ambiente.

Local de atuação

Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário

Temos 2 modelos de jornadas, 44 horas semanais (Segunda a Sexta) e Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno e Noturno).

Requisitos

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência comprovada como Bombeiro Hidráulico/Encanador.
  • Conhecimento e experiência na instalação e manutenção de sistemas de gás (Gasista).
  • Curso de Encanador e Bombeiro Hidráulico (ou formação técnica equivalente).
  • Curso de Gasista.
  • Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de projetos hidráulicos e de sistemas de gás.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis à instalações hidráulicas, sanitárias e de gás.
  • Comprometimento com a segurança e com as normas regulamentadoras (NRs).

O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver

  • Proatividade e capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma autônoma.
  • Experiência em soldagem (cobre, aço).
  • Certificações adicionais na área de segurança ou manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma clara.

Benefícios

  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
  • Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
  • Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.
  • Seguro de vida: Garante a segurança financeira da sua família em caso de imprevistos, proporcionando tranquilidade e proteção.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Overview

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan

  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Role Purpose

We are seeking a senior Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager to act as the single owner and authority for all Anatel regulatory compliance and product certification activities in Brazil.

This role is critical to ensuring the company’s ability to import, commercialize, deploy, and operate telecommunications products in the Brazilian market, while enabling speed-to-market, commercial competitiveness, and long-term regulatory sustainability.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, strong interaction with Global HQ, and direct influence on revenue, deployment, and customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of Anatel homologation and product certification activities, including planning, execution, publication, maintenance, renewals, and amendments.
  • Act as the single point of accountability with Anatel, OCDs (Designated Certification Bodies), and accredited laboratories.
  • Define and execute regulatory strategies per product family, balancing compliance, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate and validate all regulatory and technical documentation, including test reports, declarations of conformity, manuals in Portuguese, and technical files.
  • Assess the regulatory impact of hardware, firmware, RF, and configuration changes, enforcing regulatory gates and blocking deployments when compliance is at risk.
  • Ensure strict alignment between certified configurations and field-deployed products, SKUs, and software versions.
  • Support Sales, Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Supply Chain with regulatory validation for RFPs, RFQs, imports, and network deployments.
  • Maintain an audit-ready regulatory repository and manage interactions with Anatel during audits, inspections, and formal inquiries.
  • Monitor homologation validity dates and proactively manage renewals to prevent service disruption or import blocks.
  • Continuously improve certification lead time, cost efficiency, and regulatory predictability through optimization strategies.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Interface directly with Global Regulatory Affairs,, Product Engineering, Test & Certification, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Translate global product roadmaps and engineering changes into Brazilian regulatory requirements and execution plans.
  • Act as the internal regulatory authority and trusted advisor on Brazilian telecommunications regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in regulatory affairs, product certification, or compliance within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Anatel homologation processes, especially for Class III (network infrastructure) equipment.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, EMC, electrical safety, and telecom network technologies (RAN, MW, IP, Optical, CPE).
  • English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required; Advanced Mandarin is desirable.
  • Ability to operate autonomously with strong ownership, sound judgment, and assertive decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

Zero expired or non-compliant homologations.

No import blocks or deployment delays caused by regulatory issues.

Reduced certification lead time and re-test costs.

Full regulatory visibility and predictability for leadership, engineering, and sales.

Recognition as the internal authority on Anatel and Brazilian telecom regulation.

Why This Role Matters

This is strategic, technical, and business-critical role when you can face challenge and develop yourself.

Without regulatory compliance, products do not enter the country and networks do not go live.

With strong regulatory leadership, the company operates faster, safer, and more competitively in Brazil.

Are you interested in being part of our team?

Please apply for this opportunity and attach your resume in English. Kindly note that only English resumes will be considered.

Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required.

title: Chief Compliance Officer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

This position serves as the Chief Compliance Officer, overseeing the university’s compliance program, that promotes honesty, integrity and adherence to internal policies and external regulatory requirement. The Chief Compliance Officer requires extensive experience in Compliance to effectively promote a culture of integrity, advise leadership and navigate complex University operations.

The institutional Compliance Program reinforces the University’s commitment to meeting the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and responsibility, providing independent and objective oversight of the University's compliance program to ensure that the University is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations as well as University policies.

The Chief Compliance Officer will report directly to Howard University’s Office of President and to the Board of Trustees.

Supervisory Accountability

The Chief Compliance Officer will have direct supervisory oversight of the Compliance divisions across the enterprise to include Howard University, Howard University Health Sciences and Howard University Hospital.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leads the enterprise-wide Compliance program in accordance with the 7 Elements of an Effective Compliance Program as promulgated by the Federal Sentencing Guidelines by promoting and managing the University's Code of Ethical Conduct, maintaining and managing the Howard University Compliance hotline and other reporting channels facilitating and overseeing campus compliance committees, advising on conflict of interest issues and leading compliance training efforts across the enterprise.
  • Serves as liaison to the Audit and Legal Committee of Howard University’s Board of Trustees, and reporting to the committee during scheduled or ad hoc meetings to keep the Board apprised of present and emerging audit and compliance issues.
  • Meets external parties on compliance topics as a representative of the University; participates in the President’s staff meetings as requested and, represents the compliance function in various standing and ad hoc University committees and departments, and meets frequently with various groups of key administrators and leaders across the enterprise to report and advise.
  • Responsible for all administrative and leadership functions for the Office of Audit and Compliance, including hiring, supervision, and other personnel decisions; managing the departmental budget and resources effectively and efficiently; maintaining a professional audit, compliance, and Title IX staff with sufficient knowledge, skills, experience, and professional certifications to meet the requirements of internal and external directives; and overseeing departmental strategic planning.

Core Competencies

  • A minimum of 10 years of professional audit experience in a leadership position(s) preferably in higher education and research.
  • Requires in-depth knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to academic and research institutions is necessary and a high degree of competency in investigative processes and an understanding and ability for collaborative engagement within the cross-functional University operations.
  • Active participation in professional organizations in a leadership role, speaking, writing articles, or active committee participation.
  • Experience in building, training, and developing strong audit teams of five or more professional staff.
  • Experience in operational/program analysis, quality improvement, and efficiency and effectiveness reviews is a plus. Experience with a large public university system and an understanding of a university environment and its unique characteristics.
  • Knowledge of the operation of a large university system, a four-year university campus including academic areas, athletics, auxiliary services, and student services, and/or an academic health care center. The ability to prepare comprehensive reports and presentations, utilizing excellent verbal and written communication skills, public speaking, and training skills as well as excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of current compliance practices, risk assessment, and investigative processes.
  • Skill in preparing or monitoring the preparation of comprehensive reports, interpreting and applying policies and regulations, and conducting interviews. The ability to present training and information on fraud prevention, effective controls, and best practices to faculty, staff, and management.
  • Supervisory skills including the ability to motivate professional staff at different locations across the state, including educating and promoting a culture of learning while serving as a mentor and advocate.
  • Ability to organize work and prioritize objectives; to evaluate evidence; to exercise independent judgment; to plan, implement, evaluate and report activities.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining working relationships and managing and resolving conflicts with diverse constituencies across UT System.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity. Soundness of judgment is necessary to lead the institutional compliance function. Ability to effectively interact with and communicate information to senior management and the Audit and Compliance Committee, including the ability to be transparent, open, and with a demonstrated commitment to the highest ethical and professional standards.
  • Ability to be nimble, flexible, and handle ambiguity well.
  • Ability to communicate and demonstrate interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence through personal credibility, integrity, and professionalism.
  • A commitment to affirmative action, equal employment opportunity, diversity, and inclusion.

Minimum Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • Compliance Certification is required (Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP)).

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $240,000 - $260,000

title: GIG- Operador de Equipamentos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ✈️

A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG) !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;

Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts. Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship, and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies, ethical guidelines, and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement, and recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.

Core Competencies

  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required

description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior para atuar em um ecossistema de aplicativos digitais iOS e Android, com múltiplos produtos, marcas e integrações, garantindo qualidade técnica, performance e experiência consistente para o usuário final.

Você precisa ser uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia, com forte perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo, capaz de atuar em arquitetura, sustentação e evolução de apps em produção em um ambiente ágil.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicativos móveis em Flutter (Dart) para Android e iOS, desde a concepção até a publicação e manutenção, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
  • Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
  • Integrar os apps com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo autenticação, tratamento robusto de erros e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
  • Atuar na sustentação dos aplicativos: correção de bugs, investigação com logs e Crashlytics, análise de performance e prevenção de regressões.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de widgets), garantindo cobertura mínima em fluxos críticos de negócio e UI.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), contribuindo para decisões técnicas e de produto.
  • Colaborar com times de back-end, produto e design na definição de contratos de API, integrações, Design System e experiências consistentes entre plataformas.
  • Apoiar e evoluir a observabilidade dos apps (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config) e a experimentação via testes A/B.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e, quando necessário, participação em etapas técnicas de seleção (entrevistas e avaliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência sólida com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo publicação e manutenção de apps em Android e iOS.
  • Forte domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura em camadas, Clean separação de responsabilidades e gerenciamento de estado com GetX (lifecycle, .obs, Obx, GetBuilder).
  • Vivência com testes unitários e testes de widgets em Flutter, aplicados a lógica de negócio e componentes de UI.
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.
  • Conhecimento de Git (Bitbucket ou equivalentes), fluxos de pull request e práticas de code review.
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com múltiplas marcas / white-label apps, mantendo configurações distintas em um ecossistema compartilhado de packages.
  • Vivência com packages interconectados, modularização e gestão de dependências locais (path-based dependencies) e overrides.
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

Escolaridade miníma

Formação superior completa

  • Domínio das obrigações fiscais: apuração e emissão de guias de IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IOF e ISS, bem como conciliações fiscal-contábeis.

title: Assistant Registrar, Records & Registration
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students.

This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including, but not limited to, registration permissions, overrides, waitlist and batch registration.
  • Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
  • Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
  • Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
  • Produces academic standing and Deans list reports for review by the Provost’s Office and various schools and colleges.
  • Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
  • Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
  • Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
  • Develops and delivers point-of-use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
  • Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account

Core Competencies

  • Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e. Banner, Colleague, Workday).
  • Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
  • Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
  • Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
  • Detail-oriented and customer service and compliance-focused.
  • Proven record of accountability and follow-through.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar’s office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa atuará como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros, em turno 4x3. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em turno 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back.

Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entreda dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;

title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
  • Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
  • Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
  • Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
  • Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
  • Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
  • Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
  • Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
  • When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
  • Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
  • Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
  • Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
  • Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
  • Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
  • Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
  • Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
  • Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
  • Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
  • Carry out national and international trips, as needed
  • Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
  • Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
  • In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
  • Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
  • Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders

Required

  • Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
  • Active CREA registration
  • Desirable post-graduation in a related area
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD®, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
  • Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
  • Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
  • Good vision and business understanding
  • Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
  • Expertise in installation analysis
  • Experience using OrcaFlex software
  • Experience in developing tenders, including methodologies, schedules, and financial estimates/calculations
  • Experience in team leadership and team member guidance

description:
Overview

Somos um Grupo formado por marcas com mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, Paraná e Ceará, realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade valoriza profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos. Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesqueléticas e de terapia assistida. Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história; para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores.

Nossos valores

Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! Venha fazer história com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão de Contas Médicas: Coordenar as atividades de contas médicas, assegurando que todos os procedimentos e regras comerciais estejam corretamente parametrizados no sistema.
  • Gestão de Faturamento: Atuar na otimização e automação dos processos de faturamento, buscando a redução das glosas e acompanhando a performance do Faturamento, junto a coordenação do setor.

  • Gestão de Recebíveis e Glosas: Atuar na qualificação do processo de glosas (recusas de pagamento pelas operadoras), buscando a redução de perdas financeiras e acompanhando a performance dos recebíveis, junto a coordenação do setor.

  • Gestão de Atendimentos Particulares: Supervisionar o processo de pacientes particulares, incluindo a elaboração de orçamentos, cobrança (antecipada e de valores excedentes) e controle de notas fiscais.

  • Relatórios Gerenciais: Produzir relatórios e análises executivas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da gerência e diretoria.

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
InPlanet is a mission‑driven, remote‑first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO₂ while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil – where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care of Accounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You'll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically – structured, purpose‑driven, and comfortable switching between hands‑on tasks and higher‑level discussions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month‑end and year‑end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash‑flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3‑5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards, IFRS, and multi‑entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR), and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities

Key Qualities

  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard‑working and hands‑on
  • Detail‑oriented and analytical, with a problem‑solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross‑border or fast‑growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil‑based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

  1. Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  3. Optional third interview
  4. Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  5. Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  6. Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How We Support Our Colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will join a team that supports new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services.   • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience

  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

Compensation

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our expected cash compensation range for this role is:

  • $81,000 - $85,000 in New York, New York
  • $81,000 - $85,000 in San Francisco, California
