What We Offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.

  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Brazil

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Gas Master Planning Specialist to join our Gas Operations Technical Support Division (GOTSD) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)

GOTSD is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations

Your Primary role is to help translating corporate strategies into comprehensive development plans, which typically span 10 to 20 years and are used to guide capital investment decisions.

Duties and Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Assess existing facilities and infrastructure performance.
  • Forecast future demand and supply scenarios, including shifts in market dynamics, population demographics, or regulatory changes.
  • Evaluate the impact of emerging technologies and sustainability practices.
  • Develop conceptual designs and scopes for new projects or upgrades.
  • Work on facilities planning which often leads Business Master Plans and supports Facility Master Plans.
  • Ensure that all relevant data and perspectives are integrated into the plan and aligned with priorities and resource allocation.
  • Perform cost-benefit analyses.
  • Compare alternative solutions to determine the most efficient and sustainable path forward.
  • Present data-driven recommendations to support decision-making at critical milestones.
  • Schedule regular updates (typically every 3–5 years depending on the plan type).
  • Revise plans in response to major changes in assumptions, such as new market conditions, regulatory shifts, or technological advancements.
  • Ensure the plans remain relevant and actionable over time.
  • As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical or Chemical. An advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or Project Management is a plus.
  • You will have minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the oil & gas industry or energy sector, with a strong understanding of upstream operations.
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) is preferred.
  • You will have experience in developing or reviewing Master Plans for Gas industrial or infrastructure projects.
  • You will be familiar with capital planning processes, feasibility studies, and economic modeling.
  • You will have experience in working with multi-disciplinary teams and interfacing with senior management and executive stakeholders.
  • You must have a strategic thinking and long-term planning mindset as well as analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You will have project management capabilities, including scheduling, resource coordination, and milestone tracking.
  • You will have skills in planning and modeling tools (e.g., Excel, Primavera, SAP, or other enterprise planning systems)
  • You will be able to synthesize complex technical and commercial data into clear actionable plans is necessary.
  • You will be able to successfully endorse and implement capital projects based on Master Plan recommendations.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
Overview

Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro. Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado(a) futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.

Na Smart Hospital, acreditamos que a diversidade nos torna mais fortes. Nossas oportunidades são abertas a todos os talentos, com foco total na inclusão de pessoa com deficiência PCD e reabilitados pelo INSS.

Quem somos

  • Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos

  • Estamos buscando profissionais talentosos e experientes para nosso Banco de Talentos de Oficial de Manutenção. O objetivo é identificar e ter em nosso cadastro candidatos com sólido conhecimento em manutenção predial em geral, com experiência em um ou mais ofícios (como alvenaria, pintura, marcenaria, serralheria, etc.), preferencialmente em ambientes hospitalares. Você será um profissional essencial na manutenção da infraestrutura, garantindo a funcionalidade, segurança e estética das nossas instalações.

Dia a Dia

O profissional selecionado para vagas futuras poderá exercer atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva que envolvam:

  • Pintura: Preparar superfícies, aplicar tintas, massas, vernizes e outros produtos de acabamento.
  • Alvenaria e Acabamentos: Assentar tijolos, blocos, reboco, pisos, azulejos e outros revestimentos. Realizar reparos civis em telhados, lajes e calçadas.
  • Marcenaria: Analisar, confeccionar e reparar móveis e peças, trabalhando a madeira, armando partes e finalizando acabamentos.
  • Serralheria: Interpretar desenhos, realizar cortes em metais, aplicar técnicas de soldagem, modelar e montar estruturas metálicas, corrimões e grades.
  • Geral: Realizar pequenos reparos de alvenaria, hidráulica (simples) e elétrica (simples), e consertos de rachaduras e buracos. Organizar, limpar e manter o local de trabalho seguro. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no local de trabalho (incluindo o uso de EPIs) e procedimentos hospitalares. Auxiliar em outras tarefas de manutenção predial conforme a necessidade.

Local de trabalho

Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário

Temos 2 modelos de jornadas: 44 horas semanais (Segunda a Sexta) e Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno e Noturno).

Requisitos

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Fundamental Completo ou Segundo Grau Completo (dependendo da especialidade da vaga).
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência comprovada ou curso profissionalizante em uma das áreas de manutenção (Pintura, Marcenaria, Serralheria ou Alvenaria/Pedreiro).
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento sólido nas técnicas do ofício principal (leitura de desenho técnico, soldagem, uso de ferramentas e equipamentos, etc.).
  • Habilitação Profissional (quando aplicável ao ofício).

O que vamos amar se você tiver

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe.
  • Proatividade e iniciativa para antecipar problemas e buscar soluções de forma autônoma.
  • Certificação ou treinamento em segurança ocupacional (NRs como a NR-35 - Trabalho em Altura, por exemplo) será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento prático de normas de segurança no local de trabalho.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção predial em hospitais ou ambientes de saúde.

Benefícios

  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico Odontoprev e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
  • Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
  • Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida para você e sua família.
  • Seguro de vida: Garante a segurança financeira da sua família em caso de imprevistos, proporcionando tranquilidade e proteção.

Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure‑play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid‑to‑senior‑level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high‑quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision‑makers across large multinational organizations.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.

Customer Implementations

  • Lead end‑to‑end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
  • Work with key stakeholders to map customer‑specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
  • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.

Renewal & Retention Management

  • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
  • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem‑solving.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross‑sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
  • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
  • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.

Platform Mastery & Support

  • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, you will be expected to develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. This role requires you to deliver high‑level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. You’ll play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high‑quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.

Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
  • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
  • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.

Customer Reporting & Communication

  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
  • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).

Experience & Qualifications

  • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish)
  • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
  • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal‑tech, or ESG space.
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
  • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross‑functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
  • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
  • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on‑time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight‑driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self‑service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end‑to‑end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high‑quality service across customer segments.

WHS Coordinator will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in FCs to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. The WHS Coordinator will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for the associates inside operations.

You will instruct and train Operations Leaders in Amazon safety policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. You will work to identify best practices and incorporate these standard methodologies into our safety culture.

Key job responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Local Regulations and Amazon Safety Policies.
  • Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix.
  • Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
  • Deliver continuous improvement and WHSMS projects.
  • Analyze safety metrics and review incident daily, weekly and monthly incidents to discover trends to rationalize the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
  • Perform frequent site safety audits to identify all non-compliance equipment and/or processes. Implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury.
  • Audit record-keeping practices and Global Safety Database AUSTIN entries to be aligned with global safety standards and local regulation.
  • Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
  • Perform and report incident investigation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Complete high school education and Technical Course in Occupational Safetycompleted).
  • Active registration with the Professional Council (MTE).
  • Flexible schedules to adapt to work schedules (3x2, 4x3 or 6x1).
  • Experience with the Office Suite including the use of e-mail, spreadsheets, report writing, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic English language skills, especially reading.

title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Technical Services Senior Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Desejável

  • Experiência em pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas (entrevistas, testes, surveys).

Overview

Designer Jr (UX/UI) – Invillia Tecnologia – Home Office

Responsabilidades

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar na concepção de produtos digitais end to end.
  • Participar sessões de cocriação, levantando hipóteses e conceitos com stakeholders e clientes.
  • Atuar em um time multidisciplinar (negócios, tecnologia, marketing, entre outros) propondo as melhores soluções em conjunto.
  • Trabalhar com métodos de pesquisa quantitativos e qualitativos, trazendo também uma análise de mercado que conduza ao entendimento de contexto e comportamento para definir a problemática do projeto.
  • Mapear o público e definir Personas.
  • Conhecer as principais métricas do produto, acompanhando resultados e propondo estudos e melhorias contínuas baseadas nos dados (mindset de growth).
  • Ter habilidade para entregar produtos digitais visualmente impecáveis (heurística, composição, hierarquia da informação, tipografia, etc) e documentados (fluxogramas, jornada do usuário, design system, etc).

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

    The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) works closely with the Dean, Chief of Staff, Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, associate deans, faculty, staff, students, visitors, vendors, and university service partners (e Procurement, IT).

    This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

    PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

    Front Office & Executive Operations

    • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
    • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
    • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office
    • Maintain consistent front office protocols and service standards

    Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

    • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
    • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
    • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
    • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

    Student & Administrative Support Oversight

    • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination
    • Ensure adequate front office coverage and operational continuity
    • Support administrative onboarding logistics for new staff (workspace readiness, access coordination, supplies), referring all HR-related actions to the HR Operations Coordinator

    Facilities & Building Operations

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean
    • Coordinate building safety, space readiness, and maintenance requests
    • Monitor office infrastructure needs and elevate issues as appropriate to Facilities Management

    Vendor, Procurement & Resource Management

    • Coordinate procurement of goods and services in accordance with university policies
    • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and pricing coordination
    • Track contracts, service timelines, and vendor deliverables (non-legal review)
    • Maintain inventory, office supplies, and resource allocation for the Dean’s Office
    • Oversee procurement card (P-Card) activity, including transaction processing, reconciliation, and compliance with university procurement policies

    Operational Partnership & Special Projects

    • Partner with the Chief of Staff on administrative initiatives, operational improvements, and special projects
    • Support the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration with administrative coordination and operational reporting as needed
    • Identify opportunities to improve front office efficiency, service delivery, and administrative consistency
    • Coordinates domestic and international travel arrangements for the Dean, as needed, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and adherence to university travel guidelines

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver high-quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross-functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.

  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.

  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related field.
  • Expertise in software engineering.
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software.
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such as K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka).
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS.
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI frameworks.
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design.
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms, and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI).
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators).
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax.
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).
  • Exposure to developing in agile and iterative software development processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location: Brazil

Overview

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament. This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event. The role requires turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, working under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders. Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers. The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones. By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight
    • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
    • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitivenes (RFP)
    • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
    • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines
  • Scenario Planning & Risk Management
    • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
    • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
    • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control
  • Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface
    • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
    • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
    • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments
  • Data, Systems & Process Governance
    • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
    • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
    • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems
  • Tournament Scale & Complexity Management
    • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
    • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

Your Profile

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required

The Position

The Senior Retail & Licensing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Commercial Operations team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Head of Licensing & Retail and other key individuals responsible for delivering Licensing & Retail efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source, manage licensing domestic partners in coordination, collaboration and liaison with the FIFA Licensing & Retail (L&R) team in Zurich and aligned with the overall global L&R strategy to ensure the presence of a comprehensive, commercial and compelling range of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ licensed products in Brazil.

  • Work with the relevant teams in the Brazil entity to stay informed on key milestones, activations, local and domestic implementations.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of work experience in licensing and/or event retail in Brazil with preference in the sports or entertainment industry. At least 3 years’ experience leading a team.

  • Positive and can-do attitude

description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we develop solutions that power the industry that moves the world. Our flexible pipe systems rely on highly precise and reliable structural components.

The role as a Senior Programmer is an extension of the role as Programmer, and for the experienced programmer proving consistent value creation, proactive attitude, self-driven, a fast learner and high level of the relevant competencies. You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users, release often, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos.

Aqui, temos o sentimento de pertencimento, respeitamos o diverso e trabalhamos em um ambiente no qual cuidamos e somos cuidados. Nossa consciência ambiental e social está presente em todas as ações, pois temos compromisso claro com os colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores. Juntos, levamos Encantamento às mais de 600 lojas nos cinco estados do Brasil, além de Argentina e Uruguai.

Junte-se ao time de 24 mil colaboradores que estão reunidos para encantar ao lado das marcas Renner, Camicado, Youcom, Ashua, Repassa e Realize.

E aí, vem fazer moda responsável com a gente?

O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho , valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor , que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser , inovador e empreendedor , nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES®, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integram o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, e mpenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores . Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho . Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Venha para 3corações e junte seu coração aos nossos!

  • Experiência anterior com assistência técnica e/ou manutenção;
  • Curso de NR 10 - Normativo para segurança em instalações dos serviços em eletricidades;

  • Executar atividades externas de manutenção preventiva/corretiva e instalações envolvendo avaliação das condições técnicas do local para o correto funcionamento das máquinas de café;
  • Realizar instalações e orientações de uso dos equipamentos do portfólio da companhia;
  • Cumprir os indicadores relacionados a área (quantidade e tempo de atendimento, reincidência técnica);
  • Realizar o controle e emitir relatórios periodicos referente as peças sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Cuidar da manutenção e conservação do veículo, ferramentas e peças sob sua responsabilidade.

description:
Analista de Comunicação Externa Sênior - L'Oréal Grande Público

Já se imaginou fazendo parte da maior empresa de beleza do mundo?

AL'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Na L’Oréal Grande Público, nossa missão édemocratizaro melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York, a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A DPGP é a maior divisão do grupo L\'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

Missão:

Buscamos um profissional sênior com visão sistêmica para liderar a integração entre comunicação de marca e transformação social. O desafio central desta posição éconstruir uma agenda "Always On" de impacto social e sustentabilidade, com foco em comunicação, para as marcas da L’Oréal Grande Público (L’Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline NY, Niely e Colorama).

Este profissional vai liderar a estratégia que conecta os stakeholders internos e externos (ONGs, empresas parceiras, imprensa etc.) em torno de um propósito contínuo. O objetivo é garantir que o compromisso social da divisão e de marcas como L’Oréal Paris (programa StandUp) sejam um pilar perene de reputação e valor de marca, alavancando a reputação e o impacto das marcas com diferentes comunidades.

Principais Atividades:

  • Criar e gerir um calendário anual de impacto social que garanta visibilidade constante às causas da divisão, evitando hiatos de comunicação e mantendo o tema vivo para todos os stakeholders.
  • Liderar a gestão do programa StandUp em parceria com o Marketing Institucional e a ONG parceira, garantindo que a causa do combate ao assédio sexual seja um tema onipresente na narrativa de L’Oréal Paris.
  • Idealizar e operar iniciativas de sustentabilidade e impacto social dentro das ações de marca, assegurando que cada lançamento de produto ou evento tenha uma camada de propósito que reforce a reputação da divisão.
  • Atuar como o embaixador da divisão frente ao terceiro setor, estabelecendo parcerias de longo prazo que vão além do apoio financeiro, focando em cocreação e troca de expertises.
  • Mobilizar e engajar os times internos (stakeholders internos) para que a agenda social seja parte da cultura do negócio, transformando colaboradores em embaixadores das causas da divisão.
  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com jornalistas, influenciadores e formadores de opinião para garantir que as ações de impacto social tenham eco e relevância na opinião pública.
  • Apoiar o time de Comunicação e PR em ações de comunicação de marca, incluindo lançamentos e campanhas.
  • Traduzir dados e ações sociais em narrativas envolventes para imprensa e canais digitais, garantindo consistência e qualidade em todas as frentes de comunicação.
  • Analisar a performance das campanhas de comunicação e o progresso das metas sociais, sendo responsável pelos reportes de impacto.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência em Comunicação Corporativa, Brand PR ou áreas de Responsabilidade Social. Experiência prévia em comunicação e projetos de impacto social, é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de influenciar pares e lideranças internas para priorizar a agenda social no dia a dia da operação.
  • Entendimento de como o impacto social se traduz em valor de marca (brandequity) e lealdade do consumidor.
  • Perfil proativo para tirar grandes ideias do papel e gerenciar a operação detalhada de parcerias com ONGs e eventos.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Você precisa ter pelo menos 18 (dezoito) anos para se inscrever. Para mais informações sobre como usamos seus dados pessoais, consulte nossa Política de Privacidade (acesseaqui). O uso do presente site é regido pelos nossos Termos de Uso (acesseaqui)

description:
O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho , valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor , que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser , inovador e empreendedor , nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES®, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integramo o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, e mpenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores . Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho . Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Venha para 3corações e junte seu coração aos nossos!

  • Curso de NR 10 - Normativo para segurança em instalações dos serviços em eletricidades;
  • Possuir habilitação categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho de segunda a sábado;

Responsabilidades

  • Executar atividades externas de manutenção preventiva/corretiva e instalações envolvendo avaliação das condições técnicas do local para o correto funcionamento das máquinas de café;
  • Realizar instalações e orientações de uso dos equipamentos do portfólio da companhia;
  • Cumprir os indicadores relacionados a área (quantidade e tempo de atendimento, reincidência técnica);
  • Realizar o controle e emitir relatórios periodicos referente as peças sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Cuidar da manutenção e conservação do veículo, ferramentas e peças sob sua responsabilidade.

Título: Pessoa Promotor Trade Execução

Venha fazer parte do nosso time de estrelas!

Somos o Grupo HEINEKEN, lugar de gente que cultiva relações respeitosas com as nossas pessoas, sociedade e planeta. Levamos no coração o #OrgulhoHEINEKEN que reflete a paixão pela nossa história e pela qualidade indiscutível das nossas bebidas. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e sabemos que um time formado por pessoas com perfis diversos nos torna tão fortes e únicos quanto nossas marcas. Queremos inspirar e fazer parte da transformação de um mundo melhor para todas as pessoas. Não só para algumas. Esse é o nosso melhor e mais importante brinde! Aqui, nos desafiamos a ser melhores todos os dias, buscando inovação e agilidade, para levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro. E claro, nos divertimos na mesma proporção celebrando todas as nossas conquistas.

Missão do cargo

Responsável pela execução das estratégias (Fotografia de Sucesso) definidas para o canal e região nas suas lojas de atuação, garantindo a exposição e organização de nossos produtos nos clientes, assim como estabelecer um bom relacionamento, identificar novas oportunidades e atendimento com todos os stakeholders da loja, de modo a maximizar os negócios junto de seus clientes.

Principais atribuições

Visitar o piso de loja, identificando as oportunidades de execução, abastecimento gôndola primária, geladeiras e pontos extras. Organizar o estoque, garantindo que todos os produtos cadastrados na rede/loja tenham um estoque mínimo que atenda o giro x entrega, de forma organizada e limpa. Puxar os produtos para o preenchimento das oportunidades identificadas na visita e abastecer a gôndola primária, geladeiras e pontos extras, de forma organizada e com os produtos limpos. Garantir que todos os produtos estejam dentro da fotografia de sucesso HEINEKEN BRASIL e conquistar, sempre que possível, novos pontos extras e maiores espaços na gôndola. Controle do estoque virtual, acompanhando o estoque sistêmico e físico, e quando necessário fazer a sugestão de pedidos à loja; Realizar a rotação preventiva considerando o conceito “primeiro que vence e primeiro que sai” em todos os produtos do estoque, pontos extas e gônd. Garantir que todos os produtos expostos na loja estejam precificados de acordo com a política de preços definida pela HEINEKEN BRASIL, sendo eles nos pontos primários ou secundários de vendas; Realizar a ativação de todas as campanhas solicitadas com material de merchandising, racks, montagem de Materiais Permanentes etc. Realizar pesquisas de avaliação na loja, a fim de promover melhorias ou reparar possíveis desacordos com a execução padrão da HEINEKEN BRASIL. Realizar o preenchimento de relatórios da sua rotina.

Formação acadêmica

Ensino Médio Completo

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica
  • Odontológica
  • Telemedicina
  • Cartão Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • Programa ‘Conta Comigo’ (apoio psicológico, orientação jurídica ou financeira)
  • Gympass
  • Programa de Gestantes (licença maternidade 180 dias, paternidade até 30 dias)
  • Vale Alimentação*

  • Universidade HEINEKEN (cursos, parcerias educacionais, programa de idiomas)
  • Programa interno Be Leader* (fomento aprendizado, conexão líderes)

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. Trabalhamos com marcas incríveis, que as pessoas amam, e com valores que direcionam um modelo de negócio vencedor. Acreditamos no nosso #timedeestrelase oferecemos um ambiente leve, informal e respeitoso para que todas as nossas pessoas se sintam confortáveis para ser quem são e, dessa forma, sejam protagonistas de suas carreiras. É assim que caminhamos diariamente em busca da realização do nosso sonho no Brasil: levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior:

  • Represent CEx in both day-to-day and strategic meetings.

  • Must-have qualifications

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica.

Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

Descrição resumida do cargo

O/a Supervisor/a Operacional será responsável por atuar no acompanhamento e na organização das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento, dos prazos e dos procedimentos operacionais. A função é essencial para assegurar a qualidade da execução, o suporte à equipe operacional e o alinhamento das ações às diretrizes institucionais.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades do cargo

  • Supervisionar, orientar e apoiar a equipe de monitores no desempenho de suas atividades;
  • Planejar, em conjunto com o Time Educativo da Light, as atividades pedagógicas e culturais do projeto;
  • Organizar horários de trabalho, controlar a frequência e monitorar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar as atividades operacionais da Exposição;
  • Garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado ao público e a experiência dos visitantes;
  • Zelar pela correta utilização, organização e preservação dos espaços de exposição;
  • Garantir a conformidade com os regulamentos internos, saúde, segurança e preservação ambiental;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios técnicos e dos indicadores de projeto correspondentes.

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

Descrição Resumida do Cargo

O/a Supervisor/a Operacional será responsável por atuar no acompanhamento e na organização das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento, dos prazos e dos procedimentos operacionais. Somos o Grupo Rio Veículos, um grupo de concessionárias multimarcas que atua com sucesso há mais de uma década na cidade do Rio de Janeiro.

Nossa história começa com a aquisição da MIT RIO, em 2010, com lojas no Leblon e no Centro do Rio. O sucesso comercial da marca na gestão de vendas e serviços e no modelo de relacionamento com os clientes foi tão expressivo, que tornou-se imperativo replicá-lo no desenvolvimento de negócios com outras marcas. Assim surgiu a Prime Rio, concessionária Jeep, em 2016, no bairro carioca de São Conrado, que logo se estabeleceu e passou a ser a principal referência de vendas da marca na região metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Seguindo a trilha, aceitamos o desafio de utilizar o mesmo modelo exitoso de negócios para as marcas francesas Peugeot e Citroen. Desta forma, o grupo fundou a Paris Rio, em 2018, no bairro da Barra da Tijuca, onde, com o apoio da montadora, vem conquistando avanços importantes para na comunicação da qualidade das marcas e dos modelos dos veículos, bem como na excelência dos serviços prestados aos clientes. Merece destaque o prêmio de melhor concessionária no setor de pós-vendas de 2020, na região sudeste e, ainda, o fato de ser escolhida no Brasil como uma de duas concessionárias que realizam a venda e manutenção do carro elétrico Peugeot e-208. Recentemente, em 2021, a Paris Rio abriu outra loja no bairro do Recreio dos Bandeirantes, consolidando a sua posição na região.

Em 2020, foi a vez da Fiat, no Centro da Cidade. O Grupo Rio, mais uma vez na vanguarda, aceitou o desafio de abrir a primeira loja conceito do Rio de Janeiro, ampliando a sua influência local e consolidando o seu modelo de negócios já consagrado na comercialização de suas outras marcas.

Vale destacar ainda a venda de veículos seminovos exclusivos com autenticidade garantida!

E para consolidar a cadeia de valor no segmento automotivo fundamos em 2019 a Grupo Rio Seguros e em 2021 a GRP Rio, esta última, desenvolvendo serviços de assessoria automotiva e oficina premium de lanternagem e pintura na Barrinha.

Acreditamos que o que conquistamos e o que ainda está por vir é fruto de uma cultura centrada no relacionamento com os clientes e fortemente impulsionada pelo time de colaboradores que reunimos. Pessoas, processos e tecnologia é o tripé que move a concessionária mais carioca do Rio de Janeiro!

  • Controlar e alinhar as atividades das agências de eventos, fornecedores e parceiros da Comunicação Corporativa visando melhorar a operação, reduzir custos e aumentar a eficiência em termos de qualidade e entregas.

  • Planejamento de viagens e domínio do sistema de solicitação de aéreos e hospedagens.

title: Senior Global Recruiter
description:
About Nu

Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

People and Culture at Nubank

Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank´s culture.

We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders.

You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values.

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

As a Senior Recruiter, you’re expected to:

  • Own and drive full-cycle recruitment
  • Build strong, consultative partnerships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and advising on best hiring practices.
  • Source and engage passive candidates through creative channels and market research.
  • Deliver high-touch candidate experiences that reflect Nubank’s values of transparency, empathy, and simplicity.
  • Use data and metrics to inform recruiting strategies and continuously improve pipeline health and process efficiency.
  • Partner with employer branding, people analytics, and HR teams to align hiring efforts with business goals.

You will be a great fit if you have:

  • Experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in fast-paced, product-driven companies.
  • A strong understanding of the talent landscape, especially in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple searches and stakeholders with a solutions-oriented approach.
  • Experience with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, etc.).
  • Passion for candidate experience, inclusive hiring, and employer brand.
  • Advanced English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Previous exposure to fintech or hypergrowth environments.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

description:
Overview

We’re always happy to hear from talented educators who are interested in joining our teaching community at Crimson Global Academy. If you were referred to us or reached out directly, we’d love to learn more about you.

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

We’re continuously building our pool of exceptional online teachers across the following curricula:

  • A-Level / IGCSE / IAL (Pearson Edexcel)
  • US Diploma / Advanced Placement
  • Primary and LEAP

This role offers a flexible, fully remote teaching setup, allowing you to create high-quality, personalised learning experiences from home and at a schedule that works for you. You’ll be teaching in a premium one-on-one environment, supported by our full suite of curriculum-aligned resources.

If you’re passionate about student growth and excited by the idea of working with learners from around the world, we invite you to express your interest. Please submit your CV and we’ll be in touch when a suitable opportunity becomes available.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalized, high-quality instruction in a one-on-one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of bachelor’s degree in elementary education or a related field
  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • With the ability to dedicate at least 15-20 hours weekly for 6-9 months once you take a student.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A-Level / AP
  • Key Requirement: Strong knowledge and experience teaching AP or A-Level content.
  • Preferred Qualification: Prior experience preparing students for AP exams.
  • US Diploma (USDP)
  • Key Requirement: Bachelor’s degree with relevant subject credits or solid teaching experience in grades 6–12.
  • Preferred Qualification: Five or more years of classroom teaching in a school setting.
  • Primary
  • Key Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in elementary education or a related field.
  • Preferred Qualification: Experience teaching Grades 3–5 (Forms 4–6).

About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We are doing this by:

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting-edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education.

If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning—apply now!

To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories.

About QIMA

At Qima, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust. Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence. We combine on-the-ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data. We are a leading provider of supply chain compliance solutions, partnering with brands, retailers, and importers to secure, manage, and optimize their global supply network.

Company Description

Qima’s industry-leading experts for onsite inspections, supplier audits, and lab testing are supported by a digital platform that provides accuracy, transparency, and intelligence for quality and compliance data. Our culture is unique, with our 5,000 Qimates making decisions every day based on our Qima Values.

Job Description

Help us lead the strategy, design, and delivery of innovative digital solutions to enhance efficiency, client satisfaction, and compliance in the global food TIC (Testing, Inspection & Certification) industry. We are looking for an experienced Product Lead to combine business acumen, technology expertise, food quality knowledge, and emerging technologies to build scalable, data-driven products.

Key Missions

  • Product Strategy & Leadership: Define a clear product vision, roadmap, and success criteria aligned with business goals and standards (e.g., GlobalG.A.P., BRCGS). Collaborate across functions to prioritize high-value initiatives, leveraging AI and automation to improve outcomes.
  • Analysis & Solution Design: Drive requirements gathering and process mapping; create detailed functional specs, user stories, and workflows. Design robust, scalable solutions adhering to enterprise architecture, data governance, and best practices for usability and performance.
  • Project Delivery: Act as the main bridge between business, development, and QA teams. Manage agile projects from inception to release, ensuring accuracy, attention to detail, and effective resource planning.
  • Documentation & Governance: Develop and maintain comprehensive, accessible product documentation.
  • Testing & Implementation: Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validation, incorporating rapid feedback loops. Support smooth rollouts, with a focus on adoption, data integrity, and long-term product stability.
  • Field Engagement (GOOB): Engage directly with food audit operations: shadow audits, observe workflows, and capture user insights to ensure continuous improvement and strong local/global adoption.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related.
  • Experience: 6+ years in digital product management; strong track record in delivering large-scale solutions; food TIC sector experience preferred.
  • Technical Skills: Agile (Scrum/Kanban), requirements elicitation, Figma/Miro, SQL, API design/integration, AI-powered data analysis.
  • Languages: Fluent English & Portuguese; Spanish beneficial.
  • Soft Skills: Strategic thinker, exceptional attention to detail, analytical rigor, proactive problem-solving, AI literacy, stakeholder engagement, leadership, adaptability, and high standards of quality.
  • Preferred: PMI-PBA, CSPO or equivalent certifications; experience with GlobalG.A.P., BRCGS.

You Will Gain

Opportunity to lead digital transformation in food quality and compliance; collaborate with global experts; experience real-world audits; grow within an innovative, mission-driven, international organization.
